arguments.command:
cd /workspace && chmod -R u+w /workspace/tmp/candidate 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /workspace/tmp/candidate; rm -rf /workspace/project/__pycache__ /workspace/project/*/__pycache__; for t in t_lifecycle t_units t_transport t_files t_json t_edges t_policy; do printf "%-14s " $t; timeout 600 python3 tests/$t.py 2>&1 | tail -1; done; rm -rf /workspace/project/__pycache__ /workspace/project/*/__pycache__; find /workspace/project | sort; python3 -c "
import os
total=0;n=0
for root,dirs,files in os.walk('/workspace/project'):
    for f in files:
        p=os.path.join(root,f); total+=os.path.getsize(p); n+=1
print('files=%d bytes=%d' % (n,total))"
